_comment_toplevel: Task 6 CAPSTONE: gf180_j4mmu FLASH-variant `soc` (targets/asic/gf180_j4mmu/soc.vhd), rebound to genuinely instantiate the vendor-SRAM-backed macros (Task 6 PHASE A: cpus_one_m0_gf180_arch.vhd -> bootram_infer(boot_mem_gf180); ddr_ram_mux_one_cpu_idcache_gf180.vhd -> icache_adapter_gf180/dcache_adapter_gf180), integrating all 8 hardened child macros (Tasks 3-5) as LEF-only blackbox instances via a hierarchy-preserving ghdl-yosys netlist-gen (see run.sh's top-only netlist-gen override). CORE-ONLY level (no pad ring yet -- B-scope pad ring is additive/stretch per the brief's own fallback ladder; this config gives the routed CORE area, KianV-comparable to their ~13.1mm^2 core).
_comment_netlistgen: soc.v is NOT raw RTL -- it is a pre-synthesized, hierarchy-preserving generic-gate netlist (ghdl -e soc; hierarchy -top soc; blackbox <8 macro modules>; synth -top soc -flatten; write_verilog), produced by a TOP-ONLY override of the shared ghdl-yosys netlist-gen (see run.sh). The 8 macro modules (cpu/icache_adapter/dcache_adapter/bootram_infer(boot_mem_gf180)/sdram_ctrl/devices/qspi_flash_ctrl/mem_region_mux) were explicitly `blackbox`-marked BEFORE `synth -flatten`, so their internal logic/vendor-SRAM cells never got re-synthesized or flattened into the top -- only the top-level interconnect glue (aic_irq_gen, cpus' delay lanes, ddr_ram_mux's bus_mux_typec, etc, ~760 cells total) is real logic here. soc_macros_bb.v supplies `(* blackbox *)`-marked empty module declarations (matching port lists) for the 8 macros (+ the 2 leaf vendor SRAM cell types, unused at this level) so LibreLane's own Yosys.Synthesis step's hierarchy check resolves the instances without re-deriving their bodies from RTL -- LibreLane instead binds them via MACROS' lef entries below (LEF-only, no .lib -- see LEF-only-vs-.lib note in the Task 6 report; OL_TO=Magic.WriteLEF stops before any timing signoff that would need .lib).
_comment_floorplan: SCRATCHPAD-REMOVAL REPACK: boot_mem shrank from 1.127mm^2 (1033x1091um-ish) to 140x140um (0.0196mm^2) once its writable SRAM lane was removed (pure ROM now). Since row1 (icache|dcache, 1970x2570 each) already fixes the die width at 4540um regardless of boot_mem's size, and boot_mem was the only thing anchoring the old row3, the old 3-row grid (row1: icache|dcache; row2: cpu|boot_mem|devices|qspi_flash_ctrl; row3: mem_region_mux|sdram_ctrl) is repacked to 2 rows: row1 unchanged (icache|dcache), row2 = cpu|boot_mem|devices|qspi_flash_ctrl|mem_region_mux|sdram_ctrl (all six remaining macros in one row, 200um gaps), height set by the tallest item in each row (row1: icache/dcache 2570um; row2: cpu 1114.555um). This drops DIE_AREA height from 4784 to ~4300um (row3 eliminated) while width stays 4540 (still row1-bound; row2's packed width is 4536.225, within margin). Macro footprint sum = 12.489mm^2 (1.222 cpu + 5.063 icache + 5.063 dcache + 0.0196 boot_mem + 0.413 devices + 0.564 qspi_flash_ctrl + 0.090 mem_region_mux + 0.054 sdram_ctrl). New DIE_AREA (4540 x 4300 = 19.522mm^2) gives util = 12.489/19.522 = 64.0%, matching the brief's ~65% KianV-comparable target (KianV: 20.1mm^2 die at ~65% util -> ~13.1mm^2 core).
_comment_routeclean_retry: ROUTE-CLEAN RETRY (feat/gf180-librelane-die, bounded attempt): the 4540x4300 (66.6% util) 2-row repack reached placement/CTS but FAILED global routing with GRT-0118 congestion-too-high. Widened die height to 4540x4670 (21.20mm^2, ~58.9% util) for routing headroom: row1(icache|dcache) unchanged at y=200; row1->row2 gap doubled from 200 to 400um (row2 now at y=3170 instead of 2970); row2 inter-macro gaps widened from 200 to 220um (cpu/boot_mem/devices/qspi_flash_ctrl/mem_region_mux/sdram_ctrl re-spaced accordingly); margin above row2's top (cpu height 1114.555) to the die/core top grew from ~215um to ~365um. Same 8 macros, same netlist -- placement-only re-floorplan to relieve GRT-0118.
